# netskopebwan Provider

Manages Netskope Borderless WAN through its v2 API.

~> **This provider is alpha software, and its schema is subject to change.** Its resources, data sources and attributes are generated from the BWAN v2 OpenAPI specification, which is itself still changing, so any of them may be renamed, reshaped or removed in any release — including without a major version bump — and a configuration or state written against one version may need reworking for the next. Pin an exact version, and do not rely on it for production infrastructure yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    netskopebwan = {
      source = "netskopeoss/netskopebwan"
    }
  }
}

# endpoint and token default to $BWAN_ENDPOINT and $BWAN_TOKEN, which is the
# usual way to keep the token out of the configuration.
provider "netskopebwan" {
  endpoint = "https://foo.api.infiot.net"
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `enable_raw_client_template` (Boolean) Manage client template objects whose configuration the API only exposes as an opaque JSON document. Enabling this is an explicit opt-out of compatibility: these resources and data sources are NOT covered by the provider's backward-compatibility guarantees, their schemas WILL change without a major release, and they WILL be removed once typed replacements ship. - `enable_raw_policy` (Boolean) Manage policy objects whose configuration the API only exposes as an opaque JSON document. Enabling this is an explicit opt-out of compatibility: these resources and data sources are NOT covered by the provider's backward-compatibility guarantees, their schemas WILL change without a major release, and they WILL be removed once typed replacements ship. Terraform cannot validate or diff a single field of an opaque document, so a change to it is all-or-nothing.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the BWAN API, without the version prefix, e.g. https://foo.api.infiot.net. Defaults to $BWAN_ENDPOINT.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Only useful against a tenant serving a self-signed certificate.
- `request_timeout` (String) How long to wait for a single API call, as a Go duration such as "30s". Defaults to "60s".
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token used to authenticate. Defaults to $BWAN_TOKEN.
